{"code": "import warnings
warnings.filterwarnings('ignore')

# Use pandas to compute cross-tabulations
# Check if sex is balanced across arms
print("Cross-tabulation of sex by arm:")
print(pd.crosstab(df['sex'], df['arm']))

# Check if sex is balanced across severity
print("\nCross-tabulation of sex by severity:")
print(pd.crosstab(df['sex'], df['severity']))

# Check if sex is balanced across sites
print("\nCross-tabulation of sex by site:")
print(pd.crosstab(df['sex'], df['site']))

# Compute raw response rates by sex
female_response_rate = df[df['sex'] == 'F']['responded'].mean()
male_response_rate = df[df['sex'] == 'M']['responded'].mean()
raw_diff = female_response_rate - male_response_rate

print(f"\nRaw female response rate: {female_response_rate:.3f}")
print(f"Raw male response rate: {male_response_rate:.3f}")
print(f"Raw difference (F - M): {raw_diff:.3f}")"}
